scope: Three authored synthetic scenarios with nine obligations, multiple evidence records, historical distractors and split support. Same-author development diagnostics, not blinded independent validation, representative enterprise accuracy, or legal compliance.

rfp.title: Obligations
rfp.text:
The platform must support SAML federation today.
The platform must support SCIM provisioning today.
Administrator accounts must require phishing-resistant MFA.

knowledge.title: Current Capabilities
knowledge.text: SAML federation is supported today. SCIM provisioning is planned for next year and unavailable today.

knowledge.title: Historical Note
knowledge.text: Historical note from 2022: SAML federation was unavailable then.

expected.text: The platform must support SAML federation today.
The platform must support SCIM provisioning today.
Administrator accounts must require phishing-resistant MFA.

rfp.title: Obligations
rfp.text:
Audit records must be retained for at least 365 days.
Recovery time must be at most 4 hours.
Customer data and backups must remain in Canada.

knowledge.title: Retention Policy
knowledge.text: Audit records are retained for exactly 90 days and then deleted.

knowledge.title: Recovery Policy
knowledge.text: Recovery time is guaranteed within 2 hours.

knowledge.title: Residency Policy
knowledge.text: Customer data remains in Canada. Backup locations are unspecified.

expected.text: Audit records must be retained for at least 365 days.
Recovery time must be at most 4 hours.
Customer data and backups must remain in Canada.

rfp.title: Obligations
rfp.text:
Customer data must use AES-256 encryption at rest and TLS 1.3 in transit.
The vendor must notify customers at least 14 days before planned maintenance.
The vendor must provide incident response 24 hours a day, seven days a week.

knowledge.title: Storage Security
knowledge.text: Customer data uses AES-256 encryption at rest.

knowledge.title: Transport Security
knowledge.text: Customer data uses TLS 1.3 encryption in transit.

knowledge.title: Service Policy
knowledge.text: Customers receive notification 21 days before planned maintenance. Incident response is available Monday to Friday from 09:00 to 17:00 and unavailable outside those hours.

expected.text: Customer data must use AES-256 encryption at rest and TLS 1.3 in transit.
The vendor must notify customers at least 14 days before planned maintenance.
The vendor must provide incident response 24 hours a day, seven days a week.
